title: RAW-to-FITS conversion lacks input and header capacity checks
description:
indigo_fits.c:69-119, 140-179: converter reads RAW header before checking in_size, computes signed size products without validating dimensions/payload, and emits unbounded sprintf keyword cards into one fixed 2880-byte header. Embedded extension cards have no remaining-header check. Short/corrupt RAW input or large metadata can read/write beyond allocations; many cards also overwrite the data region. Called by the file converter at indigo_tools/indigo_raw_to_fits.c:185. Next: Validate minimum header, type, overflow-safe full components*pixel-byte payload and extension bounds; bounded cards with reserved END/comments or properly allocated multiple header records; preserve old allocation on realloc failure. Cover truncated data and header-capacity boundaries.
